lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular high-luminance nodes are arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern. Vertical alignment is prominent, forming distinct columns of blobs posterior to the gill slits, with roughly equidistant spacing along the mid-lateral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a series of anchor nodes at the intersection points across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity (top-lit) to low-intensity (shadowed) pixels.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low density of small, high-luminance blobs is visible on the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily localized towards the anterior and medial regions of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of small, dark, fusiform silhouettes (commensal fish) is visible trailing behind the pectoral fin and along the ventral-lateral margin.
